ValidationRule.description: For EDU, Desired Go Live Date needs to be filled in when stage is Proposal/Negotiating (60%) BOPI-600 updated to prevent auto renewals from stopping
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "B - Looker", $User.Alias <> "Workato", IsClosed = False, Probability >=0.80, RecordType.Name = 'Education', ISBLANK( Desired_Go_Live_Date__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type, "Renewal")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type, "Auto Renewal")) ) && Opp_Val_Bypass__c = false
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Enter Desired Go Live before moving to next stage.
